name: One&Only Kea Island
positioning: Villa resort on its own peninsula on Kea, the closest Cycladic island to Athens, overlooking a bay and a sandy beach
best_for: Couples wanting a private villa with its own infinity pool
Divers and sailors drawn to the Aegean
Families who want a kids club and sports center

facts.text: The resort overlooks a bay and a 100-metre sandy beach on Kea, a Cycladic island.
Kea is the closest Cycladic island to Athens.
Pools and windows frame Aegean views, with soaring atriums, open archways and lofty ceilings.
The resort was designed by architect John Heah.
The stone guests see around the resort is stone found on the peninsula, excavated and repurposed.
Each villa is decorated with original art from emerging Greek artists.
The spa was created with the wellness brand Subtle Energies.
Bond Beach Club is a restaurant with its feet in the sand, shaded by ancient trees.
The wine list has over 200 labels, around 85% of them Greek.
The resort is pet-friendly, with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.
The kids club and the Club One sports center offer a tennis court, a half basketball court and bikes for hire.

highlights.text: The resort sits on its own naturally formed peninsula with panoramic views across the Aegean.
Each room is a private villa suite set into the hillside, with a private courtyard entrance and its own infinity pool.
The spa spans three floors, with an indoor-outdoor pool, outdoor relaxation areas, and steam and sauna rooms.
Kea is surrounded by several shipwrecks, including the Britannic, sister ship to the Titanic.

considerations.text: Ferry services and private transfers between Athens and Kea are not available at night.
All transfer options are subject to weather and may be delayed or rescheduled in adverse weather.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
